Maria: hey — where's the canonical grafana/dashboard to check per-GPU SM%, GPU memory, and KV cache hit rate for redwood-lg-1? hitting some throughput regressions on Dedicated, want to rule out kvcache/batching first.
Devon: fyi there's the gpu cluster overview: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/gpu-overview (panel ids: SM%=7, KV hit=12, per-GPU mem=18). also check the model-specific tab for redwood-lg-1 batching histograms.
Sahil: if you want quick logs for kvcache misses, query Loki:
```
{app=\"runtime\"} |= \"kvcache\" | json | kv_hit==false | count_over_time({app=\"runtime\"}[5m])
```
Devon: current alert is `kvcache_hitrate < 0.65 for 5m` — that's pretty sensitive during warmup. my suggestion: change to `< 0.60 for 10m` and make it configurable per-cluster. also watch `batch_size_p99 > 32` as a signal of batching skew.
Maria: makes sense. can someone open a PR to tweak alerts + add a short runbook link on the dashboard? pinging @Kevin for memory-related thresholds.
Kevin: I can take the memory/SM tuning. for context we currently alert on `gpu_sm_util < 20% for 1m` which is noisy. recommend `gpu_sm_util < 15% for 3m` (reduces flapping during short backoffs). will add rationale in the PR.
ops-bot: deploy finished for runtime-service @ 2026-03-17T15:12:03Z :rocket:
Devon: opened MR: https://git.redwood.company/runtime/infra/mrs/512 — contains kvcache alert bump + dashboard note + runbook link. assigning Maria + Sahil for review.
Maria: thanks — I'll review this afternoon. if throughput still bad after alert tuning we'll run the kvcache hit-per-prefix drill and collect traces.
Sahil: quick note on traces: use jaeger + trace id from logs. example Loki extraction to pull trace id:
```
{app=\"runtime\"} | logfmt | line_format \"%{message}\" | regexp \"trace_id=(?<trace_id>[a-f0-9-]+)\"
```
Kevin: I'll also add a small annotation on the dashboard pointing to the per-model batch size histogram + example P99 query.
Maria: perfect — thanks everyone. if anyone notices pattern re: specific zones/hosts call it out here so we can escalate to eng-sre. :thumbsup:
